newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank report says Sweden should join EMU - radio.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank report says Sweden should join EMU - radio.

text.p: Officials at Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, have completed a report concluding Sweden should join the European Union's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) from its scheduled start in 1999, Swedish radio said.

The radio said the report emerged when the Riksbank's board met for the first time to discuss their views about an investigation carried out by a government-appointed panel headed by university professor Lars Calmfors.
Riksbank board member Birgitta Johansson told the radio that the central bank might not take a clear position on Swedish participation in EMU.
But Kjell-Olof Feldt, the head of the Riksbank board, said he would take a position, the radio said.
